finding.title: Script invocation omits working-directory context
finding.message: The command uses a repo-root-style relative path (scripts/check-daily-evaluation.py), but this README lives in docs/daily-use/ and the preceding sentence directs the reader to that directory's SESSION-LOG.md. A reader who runs the command from docs/daily-use/ will hit a file-not-found error unless the script happens to live at docs/daily-use/scripts/.
finding.suggestion: State the required working directory explicitly (or use a path that is unambiguous relative to this document), e.g. prefix the command with "From the repository root,".
finding.evidence: `python3 -B scripts/check-daily-evaluation.py --require-recorded` refuses to count repeated same-day or automated sessions as multi-day operator coverage.

fix.before: Track actual use across separate days in [SESSION-LOG.md](SESSION-LOG.md) and its metadata ledger. `python3 -B scripts/check-daily-evaluation.py --require-recorded` refuses to count repeated same-day or automated sessions as multi-day operator coverage.
fix.after: Track actual use across separate days in [SESSION-LOG.md](SESSION-LOG.md) and its metadata ledger. From the repository root, `python3 -B scripts/check-daily-evaluation.py --require-recorded` refuses to count repeated same-day or automated sessions as multi-day operator coverage.
